{{Top|leg}}
'''Ice storms''' were frequent and fast-moving storms that swept across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. They were among the greatest dangers on the ice world,<ref name="CCG-IceStormDark">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Ice Storm (Dark)}}</ref> with the intense storms known for their speed and erratic movement across the frozen planet.<ref name="CCG-IceStormLight">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Ice Storm (Light)}}</ref> After escaping from the [[Wampa cave/Legends|Wampa cave]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was caught in an ice storm raging across the [[Lanteel Glacier/Legends|Lanteel Glacier]]. Skywalker encountered the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of his mentor, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during the storm, who instructed him to travel to the [[Dagobah system/Legends|Dagobah system]]. Skywalker was discovered and rescued by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] shortly after.<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>
